mapping_json.fidelity_notes: CONE-BEHIND-TARGET cold archer. Geometry cone -- dossier is explicit: 'converts all physical to cold in a CONE behind that target, base radius 2.4m'; the cone-splash IS the identity (crosswalk s6 'cone/breath/sweep -> cone'), the arrow is the vector into it. Modeled with cone as the dominant geometry (what clears the pack every shot); extra-arrows/projectile-count for Deadeye clear noted in traits (multi_projectile is the secondary clear-scaling lane, not the identity footprint). water/cold family; chill+freeze (native shatter payoff). ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL is the capstone door -- Ice Shot's defining act is converting physical to cold (partial on-target, TOTAL in the cone; crosswalk s5 phys-to-X). ELEMENTAL_ECHO for the mono-cold amp. Asenath's Mark (auto hex/exposure/mark) + Returning Projectiles (hit twice) are endgame item accelerants noted in geometry/economy, not identity. The cone-behind-target aiming skill (line up the cone through a pack) is preserved by the cone geometry.
